neighbours.label: the slot right before a superlative or ranking ('one of' the worst, the 'most' important); the same phrases without a ranking stay quiet
fire: The country's road death rate is one of the highest in the developed world.

This valley has one of the oldest vineyards in the whole region.
Fatigue is the most common complaint among night shift workers.
The museum owns one of the largest collections of maps in Europe.
For many students, cost is the most serious barrier to higher education.
Her paper was one of the best submitted to the conference this year.
Water is the most precious resource in this dry part of the country.
quiet: The country's road network was expanded in the developed regions.

This valley has a vineyard in the north of the region.
